correctness.rationale: Each carry c_i is bounded and the first and last digit equations force c1=c_(L-1)=1. The sole apparent alternative c_(L-1)=0 is eliminated by an exact modular-3 contradiction at positions 1 and L-2. A mirrored induction then uniquely forces all internal digits to b-1. Direct place-value substitution proves sufficiency; parity and prime-factorization identities yield exactly the stated prime subcase. A fresh standalone enumerator passes 44 complete bounded domains, 1980 constructed examples, and four trial-divided primes; these finite checks are not substituted for the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The exactly motivated 2q-reversal subproblem of prime v-palindromes has an integer parameter-space classification across every base b>=4 and length L>=2. All noncongruent bases have no such affine reversals at all, each qualifying base has one at each length, and odd qualifying bases cannot produce a prime. The quadratic twin-prime condition for all two-digit prime candidates provides a natural prime-arithmetic reduction. This is a base-wide structural rigidity result linked directly to an explicit published general-base prime-v problem, not an arbitrary small numerical recomputation; no full prime-infinitude claim is made.
